criteria.requirement: Add validate_all(instance, *, raise_errors=False), ValidationIssue and MultiValidationError under attr.validation and attrs.validation. Report the first original Exception from each independent validated field in declaration order, retaining the real Attribute object, real field name and exception object. Invoke each field validator once and preserve its existing and_/or_/optional/deep fail-fast and one-pass semantics; do not reinterpret nested paths or replay validators. Continue other independent fields, catch Exception only, honor the shared validation disable switch, and optionally raise a MultiValidationError with an issues tuple. Do not mutate fields or replace ordinary attrs.validate fail-fast behavior.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
